name: REsimpli
shortDescription: Real estate CRM with calling, texting, and email on every plan, plus a 14-day trial.
longDescription: REsimpli is a real estate CRM. On October 19, 2026 the pricing page listed unlimited calling, SMS, and email on every plan, named Solo, Team, and Business by team size, with a 14-day trial. The page text we could read did not print a dollar amount. We did not start a trial.
pricingNotes: Plans are Solo, Team, and Business. The page lists unlimited calling, SMS, and email, and a 14-day trial. No dollar amount was in the text we read.
bestFor: Calling and texting owner lists from one CRM
notIdealFor: Someone who needs a published monthly price before talking to the vendor
strength: The pricing page lists unlimited calling, SMS, and email on every plan, with a 14-day trial.
weakness: The page we checked names plans by team size and does not print a dollar amount in the text.
smokeTestNotes: Pricing page checked. No account, payment, or hands-on run.

useCaseFit.find-off-market: Includes calling, texting, and email on every plan, with a 14-day trial.
